_readme: Young Women class tabs (orgs/young-women/). Rendered in the browser by orgs/young-women/classes.js, so page rebuilds keep it. classes: id (URL hash), name, ages, meets, presidency [{role,name}], advisers [names], info (one short line). Leave a field null/empty to show 'Coming soon'. NO phone numbers or other personal info for youth. activities: one object per item with class = a class id or 'all' (shows in every class tab); title, date (YYYY-MM-DD), endDate (optional), time, place, details, flyer (path from site root, e.g. 'events/flyers/x.jpg'), link (optional https URL). Items hide after their date/endDate (America/Denver).
